name: setup-deepwrought-starting-tech
description: User report (engine UI, Deepwrought): 'Choose a technology type / Get a technology' showed only 'Choose a technology (Free)' and 'Done'; the first press seemed to do nothing. Deepwrought starts with two open starting technologies, posted as two identical 'Get a Technology' + 'Done' prompts (PlayerSetupService). The first press worked, but the type picker it opened queued behind the identical second prompt (web order: every tech.choose_type ranked as an in-progress step, oldest first), so the panel looked unchanged; pressing 'Done' on that second prompt (integrator e2e pbd1410) threw away a starting technology and setup waited forever. Fix: web order leads with the step my answer opened; 'Done' on a starting prompt is greyed while starting technologies are owed and refused by the engine (TechTypeChoiceKind.validate). Here (pbd75@21: Keleres' last draft pick posts every setup prompt, Deepwrought's two included): Get a Technology -> Biotic -> Neural Motivator, Done on the remaining starting prompt is refused, then Get a Technology -> Propulsion -> Antimass Deflectors: Deepwrought owes none and setup no longer waits on it. The Done refusal needs bot dw-starttech (4980e2f); the rest passes on the old bot too.
